name.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail

caption.ja: 保存した実データ由来の分布・誤差診断。空間次元と標本/時間軸を区別します。
caption.en: Distribution and error diagnostics from actual saved data;sample/time axes are distinguished from spatial dimensions.

name.ja: Gaussian確率測度：尾確率と相関標的
name.en: Gaussian probability measures: tails and correlated targets

note.ja: 確率密度と積分のモデル。通常の重要度重みと既知分散の区間、2D相関Gaussianの量別診断を区別し、物理時間発展や一般のMCMC収束保証とは扱いません。
note.en: A probability-density/integration model. Separate ordinary importance weights/known-variance intervals and observable-specific2D Gaussian diagnostics; no physical-time or universal MCMC-convergence claim.

name.ja: 正規稀少尾の通常importance sampling
name.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail

note.ja: 通常の尤度比平均を解析モーメント・独立seed分散・有限被覆診断で確認。
note.en: Check ordinary likelihood-ratio averages with analytic moments,independent batch variance and finite coverage diagnostics.

title.ja: 正規稀少尾の通常importance sampling
title.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail

note.ja: 重み付きISへBernoulliの厳密区間を転用しません。64反復は一般95%被覆の証明でなく、nestedprefixを独立反復へ水増ししません。global weightESSと事象ESSは別です。
note.en: Bernoulli exact intervals are not applied to weighted IS.64trials do not prove general95%coverage;nested prefixes are not extra independent replicates. Global weightESS and eventESS are distinct.

reference_note.ja: 1〜4次モーメントを独立正の積分で資格。既知分散による5SE校正、seed間分散、解析分散低減、重み欠落負例。既知分散normal95%のIS区間の被覆は閾値/prefixごと64反復で別記。
reference_note.en: Qualify moments1..4 by independent positive quadrature. Gate known-variance5SE,batch variance,analytic variance reduction and omitted-weight negative control. Report known-variance normal95IScoverage separately for64trials per threshold/prefix.

method_note.ja: Y=1(X>a)exp(-aX+a²/2)の通常平均。ランダムな重み総和で割らず、proposal調整なし。直接MCの無hitは0のまま保存しCP区間を付けます。
method_note.en: Ordinary mean ofY=1(X>a)exp(-aX+a²/2),without random weight normalization or proposal tuning. Retain direct zero-hit counts with Clopper-Pearson intervals.
